question: Find the value of tan 72º - tan 27º - tan 72º tan 27º.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since 72° − 27° = 45°, we use the identity tan(A − B) = (tan A − tan B) / (1 + tan A × tan B).

⇒ tan(72° − 27°) = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

⇒ tan 45° = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

⇒ 1 = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

⇒ 1 + tan 72° × tan 27° = tan 72° − tan 27°

⇒ tan 72° − tan 27° − tan 72° × tan 27° = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: tan 72° − tan 27° − tan 72° × tan 27°

**Formula Used:**

tan(A − B) = (tan A − tan B) / (1 + tan A × tan B)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let A = 72° and B = 27°

⇒ A − B = 72° − 27° = 45°

⇒ tan(72° − 27°) = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

⇒ tan 45° = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

We know that tan 45° = 1

⇒ 1 = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

⇒ 1 + tan 72° × tan 27° = tan 72° − tan 27°

⇒ tan 72° − tan 27° − tan 72° × tan 27° = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Tangent Addition Formula

tan(A + B) = (tan A + tan B) / (1 − tan A × tan B)

Tangent Subtraction Formula

tan(A − B) = (tan A − tan B) / (1 + tan A × tan B)

Tangent Double Angle Formula

tan 2A = (2 × tan A) / (1 − tan² A)

Key Trigonometric Values

tan 45° = 1, tan 135° = −1
